content.text: Still scrolling. I'm past the pension/gemel tables and I've reached "קרנות מחקות", which is the part I actually care about.

I went through all of it, but I haven't decided anything yet. Harel has a huge amount, "כל המוצרים 105" across 96 tracks. Most of them charge around half a percent a year. The S&P 500 tracks are up about 13.7% a year over 3 years ("3 שנים 13.7%"), and the stock tracks are up even more, around 21%. What threw me is that the cheapest ones, the S&P fund at the bottom with about 0.1%, don't show any return. So I don't know what I'd actually be getting. I'm sure about the numbers I saw, but not about what to do with my 30k.

**What I looked at, in order**
- **Top:** the big "הראל" heading, then "כל המוצרים של הראל" and the row of buttons ("קופת גמל להשקעה 16", "קרן השתלמות 16", "קרנות מחקות 5", "קרנות סל 4" and so on). I didn't press any of them. I just scrolled.
- **קופת גמל להשקעה table:**
  - Fees are about 0.54–0.67%.
  - "עוקב מדד S&P 500" has 13.7% for 3 years and 11.92% for 5 years, with 2.3 billion ₪ in it.
  - "כללי" has 11.51%, and "הלכה" has 12.3%.
- **קרן השתלמות:** the same picture. The S&P track charges 0.5% and shows 13.71%, with 7.9 billion ₪ in it. Fees in this table run from 0.41% to 0.67%.
- **תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים:**
  - "גמל מסלול מניות" shows 21.37% for 3 years, which is the biggest number I saw for a track I could actually use.
  - "גמל - עוקב מדד S&P 500" shows 13.71%.
- **חיסכון לכל ילד:** fee 0.01%, one track at 21.47%. It's for kids, so I scrolled on.
- **קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן חדשה כללית (pension):** these show two fees, 0.16% plus 1.47% "מההפקדות". At that point I was bored and skimming. These are pension, not my spare money.
- **קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל:** these are the ones I actually care about. "הראל מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" shows "קבועים 0%", "משתנים 0.1%" and "נאמן 0.025%". The קרן סל S&P costs 0.6% plus 0.3%. Neither table has a return column at all.
- **Bottom:** "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל", a list of folds. I didn't open any of them.

**What I skipped:** the חשיפה circles, the קופה numbers, the line under the title about where the data comes from, the small notes under the tables (PF-06, PF-10) and the folds at the end.

**Where I got stuck**
- A lot of rows have no return number, just "פחות מ־3 שנים" and "פחות מ־5 שנים", so I couldn't compare them.
- I wasn't sure whether the S&P in the קרן מחקה and the S&P in the קופת גמל are the same thing at different prices.
- Every fee is a percent. None of them tell me what I'd pay in shekels.
- I only noticed afterwards that the return heading says "לפני דמי ניהול".

**Words I didn't get:** "מההפקדות", "אין" written in the fee column, "עוד לא דווח", "צוברת", "נאמן", "קבועים / משתנים", "מנוטרלת מט"ח", "חשיפה לדולר", "מס גם על שינויי המטבע", "4A / 4D", "ת"א-35", and "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח".

**Where I'd have quit:** the pension tables. They go on for screens and every row looks the same. On my phone I'd have closed the page there, and I'd never have reached the קרנות מחקות.
